name: OCEAN BIO-CHEM INC. Registered
summary: Ocean Bio-Chem, Inc. manufactures, markets, and distributes a broad line of appearance and maintenance products for the marine, automotive, recreational vehicle, and outdoor power equipment markets, based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The company's core products include Star brite and Star Tron fuel additives and marine maintenance products. They also provide private label manufacturing services.
